snapshot.name: Clean Science & Technology Ltd
snapshot.about: Incorporated in 2003, Clean Science and Technology Ltd is one of the leading chemical manufacturers globally. It manufactures functionally critical specialty chemicals such as Performance Chemicals (MEHQ, BHA, and AP), Pharmaceutical Intermediates (Guaiacol and DCC), and FMCG Chemicals (4-MAP and Anisole). [1]

business_mix.what_it_does: Clean Science and Technology Limited manufactures specialized chemical products including performance chemicals, pharmaceutical intermediates, FMCG chemicals, and HALS (Hindered Amine Light Stabilizers) products.
business_mix.source: Company transcript of conference call on Q2 FY26-27 Earnings

guidance.statement: Capacity utilization is expected to reach 55% to 60% in the coming few quarters.
guidance.quote: going forward, we expect that the coming few quarters, we should touch between 55% to 60% capacity utilization.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Gross margins will improve due to starting key starting materials for HALS products.
guidance.quote: starting some of the key starting materials for some of these HALS products, which eventually will result in improvement in our gross margin.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Margins will keep improving quarter-on-quarter as higher grade of HALS picks up.
guidance.quote: margins will also keep improving quarter-on-quarter.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Backward integration will improve margins in HALS products by 5% to 7%.
guidance.quote: There could be between 5%, 7% improvement in margins for those particular segment of HALS.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Overall capacity will increase to close to 12,500 tons with advanced grade HALS additions.
guidance.quote: That will take out our overall capacity to close to 12,500 tons.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Targeting INR 250-300 crores revenue this year, representing 30-35% growth.
guidance.quote: revenue this year, the target is between INR250 crores to INR300 crores, okay? So that could be around 30% to 35% of overall revenue growth.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Investing about INR 25 crores for the NOR alkoxy HALS product.
guidance.quote: we will be putting about INR25-odd crores.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Kemin offtake is expected to increase by 20% to 40%.
guidance.quote: Kemin, probably our offtake will increase by 20% to 40%.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: EBITDA margins will keep improving as we sell more higher grade products.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margins will keep improving, because as we get into sales of more and more higher grade, the EBITDA margins will keep improving.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: We may undertake greenfield capex in the later half of FY27.
guidance.quote: We may also plan to undertake a greenfield capex. No, it could be in the later half of FY27.
guidance.speaker: Pratik Bora

guidance.statement: Expecting revenue of INR 260 crores for Performance Chemical 1 at around 80% capacity utilization.
guidance.quote: around 80% capacity utilization, we are looking at a revenue of INR260 crores
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Performance Chemical 2 facility will begin by May, June, with revenues expected only in Q4.
guidance.quote: the facility will only begin by May, June. And we expect after teething issues, customer approvals, we should only see revenues in Q4.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Targeting around 50% utilization over a 2-year period for new commercialized products.
guidance.quote: target remains like that's typically with any new product which we are commercializing at least around 50% of utilization over a 2-year period.
guidance.speaker: Management

guidance.statement: Exports will quickly start ramping up as we move into quarter 4 and 27.
guidance.quote: we expect the exports to quickly start ramping up.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Expecting decent numbers in FY27 from the newly started plant.
guidance.quote: we expect decent numbers coming in FY '27.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Expect sequential growth in Q3 and Q4, though unquantified.
guidance.quote: we expect a good growth, I mean at least a sequential growth, but we do not want to quantify it at this stage.
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Envisage revenue of about INR300 crores on full-scale capacity for performance chemicals.
guidance.quote: envisage a revenue of about INR300 odd crores with the current prices
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

guidance.statement: Expect the HALS business to keep growing on a quarter-to-quarter basis.
guidance.quote: our endeavour is to keep growing this on a quarter-to-quarter basis
guidance.speaker: Siddharth Sikchi

bull: Strong balance sheet with a Debt to Equity ratio of 0.00 and investments of 397 Cr exceeding borrowings of 2 Cr.
Recent quarterly revenue grew by 22 percent year over year, with an EBITDA increase of 6 percent.
Generated a 5 year free cash flow of 240 Cr, remaining positive in 4 out of 5 years.
bear: Growth is slowing significantly, as the 3 year revenue CAGR dropped to 1 percent compared to 13 percent over 5 years.
Margins are compressing with the current OPM at 37 percent compared to the historical average of 44 percent.
Working capital is stretching, with the cash conversion cycle increasing from 99 to 118 days.
bull_bear.what_would_change_my_mind: A sustained acceleration in PAT growth matching revenue expansion and a reversal in margin compression would change my mind.
untraced: Generated a 5 year free cash flow of 240 Cr, remaining positive in 4 out of 5 years.
